paragraphs:
I'm a Product Designer based in Berlin, working mostly on fintech and B2B SaaS products, with a background in architecture and UX research.

Architecture taught me to think in systems and constraints, and to design with implementation in mind. A good idea only matters if it can actually be built.

That way of thinking eventually led me into UX research and product design. Research taught me not to jump into solutions too quickly, but to let user insights, behavioral data, and business context shape product direction and inform strategy.

Today, I work across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and product definition to interaction design, prototyping, validation, and design systems. I'm at my best on complex products and ambiguous problems, collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to turn complexity into products that feel simple.
